category: website experience analytics: session replays, heatmaps, funnels and surveys (hosted)

free_tier.stated: Free plan at $0 forever: up to 200k monthly sessions, 1 project, 1 month of data access, replays, heatmaps and funnels, error and performance monitoring and basic surveys; session replays capture 5% of sessions up to 10k a month and the APIs are not included
free_tier.notes: The allowance mixes monthly analytics sessions with a capped share of recorded replays, so no single unit of the vocabulary fits. The sign-up page of the Free plan is hosted by Contentsquare.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-session or per-event size is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: 1 month of analytics data access on Free, against 13 months on Growth and above; session replays are accessible 1 month

egress.terms: unverified: no export allowance is stated on the pricing page; the APIs row lists Not included for Free

interface_detail: A tracking script feeds the web app; the pricing table lists the APIs as not included on Free and an MCP connection as up to 300 tool calls a month, and the interface vocabulary has no term for a browser-only service.
tooling: the tracking script and the web app; an MCP connection with up to 300 tool calls a month
chaining: Session replays, heatmaps and funnels for one free-hosted site, with analytics collected on up to 200k sessions a month and replays on a 5% sample.

limits.value: up to 200k monthly sessions and 1 project on Free
session replay capture of 5% of sessions, at most 10k a month
1 month of analytics data access and of session replay access

limits_note: Free has no APIs and no alerts.
binding_note: The 5% replay sample capped at 10k a month limits what can be watched, before the 200k analytics sessions matter.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page asks for a country and an email address, or Google sign-in; the pricing page states no credit card term for Free. Whether a later step asks for a card or a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: no throttle, ban or data loss is stated on the pages read beyond the 1-month data access
confidence_note: Plan limits are quoted from the first-party pricing page and the sign-up fields from the sign-up page. No account was opened, so the card term and later steps are unverified: behind a sign-up.
